name: Wallabag with SQLite
description: Persist articles, database and downloaded images in separate named volumes.

hostname.label: Initial hostname (change public URL later in app settings)

instructions: Review the generated Compose and environment before starting. Only the app HTTP port is published, on loopback.
Keep credentials, database and data volumes together in an independent backup. Exported Compose files do not include volume data.
Wallabag initially creates the wallabag account. Run the Change user password action with a new password immediately; keep the app private until complete.
Downloaded images and the SQLite database both need backup.

requirements.label: Change the initial wallabag account password with the native action before exposing this app beyond loopback.
